verdicts.explanation: The main text reports an average conductivity for random dopant distributions of 0.06 S cm-1, cited to the authors' previous KMC study (ref 11), so literature_cited is correct. The paper gives no measurement temperature for this value, so null is right, and the secondary fields are correctly null.

The experimentally reported bulk 8YSZ conductivity of 0.0505 S cm-1 is taken from ref 27 (Yamahara et al.), so literature_cited is correct. The paper gives no measurement temperature, so null is right; the SI caption quote matches the value.
